mapper.sql: video_id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt = #{attempt} AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_video_asr_tasks (video_id) VALUES (#{id}) ON CONFLICT (video_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE local_video_asr_tasks SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt = attempt + 1, lease_until = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE video_id = (SELECT video_id FROM local_video_asr_tasks WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY updated_at, video_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING video_id, status, attempt, error_code, source_id, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE local_video_asr_tasks SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = 'ASR_LEASE_EXPIRED', lease_until = NULL, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= clock_timestamp()
UPDATE local_video_asr_tasks SET status = 'QUEUED', error_code = NULL, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE video_id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
UPDATE local_video_asr_tasks SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', source_id = #{sourceId}, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE
UPDATE local_video_asr_tasks SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{error}, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE
